# CultEngine

> Unified cultural club management platform for IIT Roorkee — auditions, members, contingent selection, analytics and events across 13 clubs.

CultEngine helps the Cultural Council and club leads run auditions, track talent with a Contingent Selection Score (CSS), build inter-college contingents, manage assets, and coordinate events from one workspace.

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Overview of club health, activity, audition funnel and upcoming events.
- [Members](/members): Roster of cultural members across all 13 clubs.
- [Clubs](/clubs): Directory of the 13 cultural clubs with health and leadership.
- [Council](/council): Cultural Council leadership.
- [Auditions](/auditions): Audition submissions and applicant tracking.
- [Contingent](/contingent): CSS-based contingent builder for inter-college events.
- [Analytics](/analytics): CSS calculator, club performance index and section health.
- [MVPs](/mvp): Standout cultural performers.
- [Calendar](/calendar): Cultural events, rehearsals and audition schedule.
- [Announcements](/announcements): Broadcasts across clubs.
- [Assets](/assets): Shared file vault for clubs.
- [Tasks](/tasks): Kanban tracker for cultural operations.

## Optional

- [Vault](/vault): Archive of records and institutional memory.
- [Settings](/settings): Workspace configuration.
